## Project identity
**Descriptive name:** **Hands-on IBM Cloud Db2 Provisioning and Data Loading Practice**

A hands-on IBM Cloud learning repository documenting Db2 service-instance creation, table creation/data loading, a troubleshooting fallback from a failing UI load path to SQL entry, saving SQL for rollback intent, and exporting DB2 data to CSV. A Watson ML folder contains only a screenshot, so machine-learning cloud capability is not inferred beyond very light exposure.

Correct classification:

> **A hands-on IBM Cloud learning repository documenting Db2 service-instance creation, table creation/data loading, a troubleshooting fallback from a failing UI load path to SQL entry, saving SQL for rollback intent, and exporting DB2 data to CSV. A Watson ML folder contains only a screenshot, so machine-learning cloud capability is not inferred beyond very light exposure.**
